protocol.order: ABBA per group per suite; suites and sizes in supplied order
protocol.statistics: median/p90/MAD from all rounds; operations=sum within round; process medians and group changes retained
protocol.noise: flag round MAD >20%, process-median MAD >10%, or opposite group changes beyond +/-5%; repeat flagged suites with two more full ABBA groups once, retain both batches; unresolved variation is inconclusive
